mentions.name: Pelican Tools
mentions.description: A collection of tools for reworking YouTube content: any YouTube video can be transcribed into elegant text or a complete article. The whole thing runs on Vercel and is a work in progress.
mentions.problem: Getting the value out of YouTube videos without having to consume them fully
mentions.audience: Creators, researchers and developers looking to reap the rewards of a video without consuming it fully
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently developing https://pelicantools.app, a collection of tools to rework YouTube. Any YouTube video can be transcribed to an elegant text or a complete article.
